q1_issues.issue: the antecedent of the 'when'-conditional is asserted as a standing fact at 1.0/0.99 -- the flat (Member sk_store_1 large) plus the reified sk_large_1 state claim the Watch's feather store IS large, which the sentence only supposes.

the consequent is likewise asserted outright (tend event, Agent, Theme, Manner), so a present-tense habitual regularity is recorded as two standing facts joined by During and the conditional force of 'when' is lost entirely; the instruction set's own 'when' paragraph forbids leaving a genuine regularity unquantified.

the per-member distribution rule fires at strength 1.0 with no conditioning at all -- it drops even the During sk_large_1 link the group event carries, so each Keeper's tending is unconditional on the parse's own analysis.

q2_gaps: a habitual / generic 'when P, Q' whose participants are all DEFINITE: the 'Bare when P, Q routes by P's referents' rule offers only (a) generic or indefinite participants -> the whenever occurrence-rule, and (b) definite/specific participants IN A ONE-OFF NARRATIVE -> two plain events ordered by During/Before; a present-tense regularity over definite individuals ('the Watch's feather store', 'the Keepers', 'the Sunken Cove lanterns') falls between the two boxes, and the whenever machinery's premises are built from plain variables that a definite state clause supplies nowhere

a capitalized plural kind-word label with no name-hood signal ('the Keepers'): Names and casing declares the capitalized-common-noun default 'singular-collective only' and makes a capitalized plural kind-word label referring as a name a Name-only individual with no GroupOf, but supplies no test for when such a plural is 'referring as a name'
notes: The NP work is exactly to spec: 'the Watch' as a capitalized singular collective with typing and no Name atom, 'Sunken Cove' as one opaque multi-word name symbol with a separate (Member sunken_cove cove) type atom and no modifier genus, the proper-noun premodifier linked to the lantern group by opaque Possession, feather_store fused with genus store and its noun modifier unexposed, and 'safely' kept in surface adverb form under Manner.
